_comment: Read by scripts/make_mesh.py, scripts/unit_patches.py and scripts/make_case.py. The values are the solved runs'. Metres, kelvin, kg/s, watts.
_boxes: x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1; the unit and the desk top are each written as one closed STL by make_mesh.py

ports._ports: faces of snappyHexMesh's unitWall patch moved into these patches by unit_patches.py, by face centre; the areas are checked to 1%

_massFlow: kg/s through the half unit: 390 CFM, the MSZ-GS12NA's top heating airflow, at 15 C, halved
_Q: W of heat into the half room: the rated 14,400 BTU/h (4.22 kW) at 47 F outside, halved
_direction: the jet's direction at the active slot: 15 degrees above horizontal (up) or 60 degrees below (down)

layers._layers: storedLayerWall79 on unitSideWall, farWall, sideWall and ceiling (12.7 mm gypsum) and on the floor (19 mm wood), 24 layers each, starting at T0, adiabatic backs; written into 0/T as given
